item.tib: tshe dbang dz+wa this rigs lnga'i skong mdos ri rab lhun po
item.coloph: phyi rabs gshen po nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir/ mu la'i mtshan 'chang bdag gis 'di bzhin sbyar/ las ldan gshen la gtad do gces par bzungs (zungs)/ dus kyi tha mar bon chos dar nub skabs/ bA+e ro la sogs grub pa'i gshen po yi/ brda ris bris te zhang zhung sgo yi gnas/ rtse drug byang nub rin chen brag la sbos/ gter srung rnams kyis ma g.yel bya ra gzobs/ phyi ru brten rten 'brel phun 'tshogs (tshogs) lnga shar tshe/ nges med sprul sku gcig gi rnyed par shog sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya phyis su bdag 'dra gshen sprul thugs rje nyi mas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i brag dmar tsi ta 'dra ba'i ngos nas / zab mo gter gyi dngos grub rnyed de gsang rgya sdam (bsdams)/ slar hor sras mchog gi thugs bzhed dang/ blon bra bo rgya mtsho/ grwa g.yung 'od / ye tshul rgyal bstan sogs kyis bskul ngor gshen gyi bla brang du shog ser yig tu phab pa'o//
